findings.evidence: The declarations at lines 835 and 840 characterize stageSubcomplex; the @[simp] lemmas coe_unionStageSubcomplex and unionStageSubcomplex_I already characterize its canonical-union specialization.
findings.fix: Remove @[expose] from both definitions; use the existing projection lemmas and mark coe_stageSubcomplex and stageSubcomplex_I @[simp].
findings.issue: Both stageSubcomplex and unionStageSubcomplex (line 1084) expose their bodies solely to reduce carrier and cell-index projections, coupling consumers to their implementation.

findings.evidence: Their statements use only Sigma, Subtype, natural-number bounds, and Sum; their proofs use only natural-number arithmetic and dependent transport.
findings.fix: Generalize them to an arbitrary family ℕ → Type*, relocate them to general equivalence infrastructure, and export them with application lemmas.
findings.issue: stageIndexZeroEquiv and stageIndexSuccEquiv (line 331) hide general dependent-sum prefix equivalences that have no CW-specific assumptions or proof dependencies.

summary: The interface exposes subcomplex implementation bodies unnecessarily and hides reusable finite-prefix equivalences as private helpers.
